propositions: Completion-verification close gate fails to detect runaway tool-call loops during the verify step, causing budget exhaustion and bare LLMError with null diagnostic instead of routing to bounded recovery with fresh per-criterion evidence

Tool-step-limit empty-filter rewrite in agent_call.py causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 error (toolConfig must be defined when history contains toolUse blocks) by emptying the tool surface mid-run after tool calls have occurred

Budget exhaustion in CompletionAgentStep.run only catches UnretryableOutputError, preventing bounded recovery from being reached; repetition diagnostic is computed but not surfaced in gate_error_v1 sidecar

Windowed distinct-ratio metric (window 24, trip <= 0.50) distinguishes k-cycles from healthy breadth but is not wired as the runaway detector or used to classify failures before provider-outage fallback in interpret_failure
Request and tool-call usage (including loop-vs-breadth axis) is not recorded durably by default, preventing the gate from being tuned from production data
